title: API Request Timeout or Chunk Transmission Failure
body:
**Bug Description**
Right in the middle of working on something, it's suddenly giving me "API Error: request ended without sending any chunks". Google has 0 results for this error. 

**Environment Info**
- Platform: macos
- Terminal: Apple_Terminal
- Version: 0.2.36
- Feedback ID: f0e2baf0-9597-42a8-b987-6bf95dd80281
